info.title: Expense Manager API
info.description: API for storing and viewing personal expenses. See Appendix for changes from the original brief specification.

get.summary: List all expenses, optionally filtered by type

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: ADDED (future feature): filter results to a single expense type.

200.description: A list of expenses, filtered by type if provided

get.summary: Get a single expense by ID

cost.description: CHANGED: renamed from cost_gbp to cost — see Appendix.

x-appendix-of-changes: Renamed the monetary field from 'cost_gbp' to a currency-neutral 'cost' because the brief's Basic Requirements text and OpenAPI description conflicted (rupees vs GBP). Documented and justified this decision in the submission report.
Added GET /api/expenses/{id} as a distinct endpoint for viewing individual expense detail, per the Basic Requirements.
Constrained expense_type to an enum (travel, food, other) matching the brief exactly.

ADDED (future feature, beyond basic requirements): GET /api/expenses now accepts an optional ?type= query parameter to filter by expense_type. Validated against the same enum used for storage; returns 422 for an invalid value. Backward compatible — omitting the parameter returns all expenses as before.
